decisions.rule: The repeated 400-case exact-contract batteries are one shared internal specification-test family and are not external replications.
A paper remains separately publishable only after its own frozen external gate passes on the named disjoint evidence partition.
Consolidate certificate, closure and authority calculus unless each component passes a distinct external discriminator.
P9 remains standalone only after the locked replay discrepancy is resolved.
P10 remains an execution programme until H1-H6 have been run under the frozen design.
Publish P12 separately only if its frozen successor study passes; otherwise publish the bounded null/boundary result and stop the positive claim.
Consolidate P13 and P14 around machine-verifiable lifecycle-contract safety; broader governance claims remain CANNOT_CHECK without independent human adjudication.
Consolidate P15 and Q3 as one software/instrument paper and package.

non_bypass_boundaries: Public online data does not create independent adjudication.
An AI session, local hash, same-owner replay or same-owner CI does not create protected confirmation.
Missing license, gold, comparator, custody or semantic authority remains CANNOT_CHECK.
This disposition record changes portfolio structure only and cannot promote a paper score.
